title: 第200章 千手素心功的妙用第199章 王啸死
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
lines: 叶弑天轻哼一声：“随手抢的罢了！这些都是垃圾，为师当年没地方用，才选择在这里存起来。”
“本来灵石更多，这几百年以来，洞穴的阵法估计都消耗了不少灵石。”
叶凡从叶薇妮手里，接过统计表。
扫了一眼！
眸光微微波动：“师父，那么……你……到底是不是叶家先祖？”
“咳咳……为什么非要问这个问题？”叶弑天干咳两声。
叶凡道：“师父！这当然要弄清楚。”
“您的宝库在此，叶家也扎根于此！若您是叶家先祖，这岂不是冥冥之中的定数吗？”
叶弑天沉默几秒钟。
淡淡吐出三个字：“我不是！”
叶凡眉头一挑：“师父，您怎么这么肯定！”
叶弑天有些烦躁：“小子！别问了！”
叶凡打破砂锅问到底：“师父！如果您真的是叶家先祖，又是我师父，我们岂不是亲上加亲？”
“小子！你非要刺激我是吧？”
叶弑天有些无语：“你师父我，就没有后人！”
叶凡疑惑：“为什么？”
叶弑天都破防了，很想现在跳出混沌空间，掐死叶凡：“混账小子！你想知道？好啊！为师告诉你，因为为师当年是纯爱战士！”
“我当年，只爱洛清漪一个女人！”
“草！老子到死，还是处男一个！你满意了吗？”
“老子一个没碰过女人的处男，怎么有后人的？来来来，乖徒儿快进入混沌空间，为师觉得你的天罚九剑还没完全领悟透彻，进来！为师再指点你一下！”
“不不不，不用了！”
叶凡有些心虚。
果断切断和混沌空间的联系。
来到叶傅身前：“爷爷，隐世叶家，不能再待了。”
叶傅沉默几秒钟，点了点头。
王啸死在这里，中州王家不可能善罢甘休！
叶凡和叶家一百多人，快速行动，将所有宝物全都收走，那两千亿灵石，都被叶凡收入混沌空间。
离开宝库后，叶家众人又收拾好一切行李！
一个时辰后，站在叶家山谷的入口。
“这么多年了，突然要离开，还是有些不舍。”叶傅长叹一声。
叶凡道：“爷爷，去大夏龙都，一样可以再建立起一个叶家！待在世俗界，有圣地的规矩限制，王家不敢直接杀人，有利于你们的安全。”

Ye Shitian snorted softly: "It's just a random grab! These are all garbage. I had no place to use them back then, so I chose to store them here."
"Originally there were more spirit stones. Over the past few hundred years, the formation in the cave has probably consumed a lot of spirit stones."
Ye Fan took the statistics table from Ye Weini.
Take a look!
His eyes fluctuated slightly: "Master, then...are you...the ancestor of the Ye family?"
"Ahem...why do you have to ask this question?" Ye Shitian coughed twice.
Ye Fan said: "Master! Of course we have to figure this out."
"Your treasure house is here, and the Ye family is also rooted here! If you are the ancestor of the Ye family, isn't this a destiny?"
Ye Shitian was silent for a few seconds.
He said three words calmly: "I'm not!"
Ye Fan raised his eyebrows: "Master, how can you be so sure!"
Ye Shitian was a little irritated: "Boy! Stop asking!"
Ye Fan broke the casserole and asked: "Master! If you are really the ancestor of the Ye family and my master, wouldn't we be more intimately related?"
"Boy! You have to stimulate me, don't you?"
Ye Shitian was speechless: "Your master and I have no descendants!"
Ye Fan was confused: "Why?"
"Grass..."
Ye Shitian's defense was broken, and he really wanted to jump out of the chaotic space and strangle Ye Fan to death: "You bastard! You want to know? Okay! I will tell you, because I was a pure love warrior back then!"
"Back then, I only loved one woman, Luo Qingyi!"
"Fuck! I will still be a virgin until the day I die! Are you satisfied?"
"How can I, a virgin who has never touched a woman, have descendants? Come on, my good disciple, enter the chaotic space. I think you haven't fully understood the Nine Swords of Heaven's Punishment yet. Come in! I will give you some pointers!"
"No, no, no, no need!"
Ye Fan felt guilty.
Decisively cut off the connection with the chaotic space.
Arriving in front of Master Ye: "Grandpa, we can't stay in the hidden Ye family any longer."
Ye Fu was silent for a few seconds and nodded.
Wang Xiao died here, and the Wang family in Zhongzhou could not let it go!
Ye Fan and more than a hundred people from the Ye family acted quickly to collect all the treasures. The two hundred billion spiritual stones were collected by Ye Fan into the chaotic space.
After leaving the treasure house, everyone in the Ye family packed all their luggage!
An hour later, he stood at the entrance of Yejia Valley.
"After so many years, I'm still a little bit reluctant to leave suddenly." Ye Fu sighed.
Ye Fan said: "Grandpa, if you go to Daxia Longdu, you can build another Ye family! Staying in the secular world is restricted by the rules of the Holy Land. The Wang family dare not kill people directly, which is conducive to your safety."
